# Bid the extra days and the pump-outs, not the Saturday headcount.

> Price a portable restroom (porta potty) event rental from days on site, pump-outs, and two round trips — not a Saturday headcount special. See walk-away price, price per unit-day, and a starting fleet estimate.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
